overall.one_line_summary: The corrected G0 record and effective task-evidence heads close the former F0 authorization gap without opening F1 or making scientific claims.
strengths: The typed, immutable G0 record names Phase F0 and Tasks F0.1-F0.3, binds both verified evidence manifests, and explicitly leaves F1 locked behind G1.
Canonical completion derives from validated task-evidence records; Linear, Dashboard, Brain, and MLflow remain rebuildable projections rather than approval or scientific truth.
The package preserves protected boundaries and reports fixture evidence separately from development, descriptive, and confirmation evidence.
weaknesses: No scientific run bundle exists at F0, so development, descriptive, and confirmation evidence remain not assessable by design.

The broad Brain template test suite includes pre-existing infrastructure failures outside the two corrected projection notes, although the relevant frontmatter, wikilink, Literature, and QMD checks pass.

strengths: The evidence directly tests F0 integrity, migration, projection, and owner-workflow claims.
weaknesses: The package cannot support a retrieval or optimizer-effect claim because no scientific execution was authorized.
suggestions: Keep later scientific claims bound only to validated run manifests and aggregate result artifacts.

strengths: F0 acceptance is expressed through exact hashes, protected-drift checks, validator outcomes, typed decision scope, and append-only evidence heads.
weaknesses: External projection readbacks still require local operational verification rather than one canonical cross-system manifest.

strengths: The package binds environment, dependency lock, code and document hashes, protected comparison, validator receipts, and projection counts without inventing metrics.

findings.evidence_locator: Direct local Git and QMD readback of brain/Key Decisions.md and work/active/myIS Research/myIS Research.md
findings.observation: The prior Brain projection used a non-existent full Research commit hash sharing the same seven-character prefix as the canonical commit; the current Brain revision corrects both restatements.
findings.reasoning: Short-hash equality can conceal full-hash provenance drift even when the human-readable projection appears aligned.
findings.suggestion: Compare and store full cross-repository commit hashes in future projection validation.

findings.evidence_locator: Local Node test readback: 583 passed and 5 failed because referenced .shardmind/.github template files or a shard fingerprint contract were absent or mismatched
findings.observation: The broad Brain template suite is not fully green, while the F0-relevant frontmatter and wikilink tests pass 31 of 31, Literature validates 153 notes, and QMD reads the corrected pointer.
findings.reasoning: These failures do not invalidate canonical Research evidence, but they prevent an unqualified claim that every Brain infrastructure test passes.
findings.suggestion: Resolve the Brain template infrastructure failures under a separately scoped maintenance task before using the broad suite as an acceptance gate.

findings.evidence_locator: Null or unresolved run-specific split, evaluator, isolation, provider, environment, and artifact commitments
findings.observation: The template is correctly non-executable at F0 and no measured manifest or scientific result was created.
findings.reasoning: A later phase would lose reproducibility and Gate discipline if it treated the planning template as a frozen run manifest.
findings.suggestion: Resolve all applicable commitments from validated artifacts and a named Owner decision before F1 or later execution.
